reviews.comment:
Dan asco. Todos los sabados en la madrugada (5 AM), cargo nafta y siempre lo mismo. 1 solo playero para mas de 10 autos con solo 2 surtidores habilitados. Lo que deberia ser una maniobra rapida, se transforma en terapia de paciencia, mas de 20 minutos de espera. Pienso que, deberian tener 2 playeros o bien, habilitar auto surtidores. Hay que comenzar a pensar un poco mas en el cliente y el servicio me parece.

(Translated by Google)
They're disgusting. Every Saturday at 5 AM, I fill up my tank and it's always the same. Just one attendant for more than 10 cars with only two pumps working. What should be a quick process turns into a test of patience, with waits of over 20 minutes. I think they should have two attendants or at least enable drive-through pumps. They need to start thinking a little more about the customer and the service, it seems to me.
